3DCubeGen Documentation

3DCubeGen is a Python toolkit for reconstructing 3D astronomical data cubes from IFU (Integral Field Unit) spectrograph observations. It converts Row-Stacked Spectra (RSS) data into regular 3D cubes and 2D maps using weighted kernel interpolation. Three spectrographs are supported: LVM (SDSS Local Volume Mapping), MEGARA (GTC), and VirusP (HET).
